environment: Existing staging testnet; Tokyo browser, APAC home, HKG Gateway and custody-role databases.
limitations: Three new wallets per arm; baseline, candidate, repeated baseline. This does not establish a latency guarantee.
The SDK is fixed in all arms, with early preflights and no HTTP request interception.
Funding and blockchain confirmation are excluded. Interaction-inclusive registration is retained separately.
The first wallet after each activation can include a cold Worker. No controlled cold-start claim is made.
Both arms overlap sealing with publication. The candidate sends Console completion before sealing starts and overlaps initial home and journal reads.
D1 totals exclude custody-role databases and calls pending when the response was captured. SQL statements are counted separately.
Whole Worker invocation CPU and wall times can include background work. Overlapping spans must not be added.
